<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/installer/pull/10688):

>Sovereign cloud GCP credential JSON does not populate the project_id field, causing the bootstrap gather to fail with RESOURCE_PROJECT_INVALID when calling the Compute API. Use metadata.GCP.ProjectID from the install config instead of credentials.ProjectID, matching the pattern already used by the GCP destroy code.

</details>
